title: ~/.yaw/comfort.yaml
description: Personal comfort settings (ADR-0030, ADR-0013): hygiene thresholds (doc 11 §1), notification channels (doc 11 §2). Lives in the user's home, never in a repository. YAW reads it and never writes it, so comments and the ntfy topic (which acts as a password) stay as the user left them.

features.description: Comfort features on for this user in every project; overrides the project's user.comfort answer.

drift.description: Topic drift threshold (1 - cosine), smoothed over the last two prompts.

maxKbPerPrompt.description: Transcript size per prompt, in KB.

cooldownPrompts.description: Show the hint at most once per this many prompts.

minutes.description: Notify only when a run took at least this long.

terminal.description: Terminal notification: OSC 9 or OSC 777, or off.

server.description: https URL (http only for localhost); default https://ntfy.sh.

topic.description: Acts as a password: long and random, or self-host with auth.
